thought.text: Widget tidak terdeteksi sebagai iframe di headless — Turnstile tidak render. Ini masalah umum di headless. Saya pakai mode **headed** dengan Xvfb.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && (which Xvfb || (apt-get install -y -qq xvfb 2>&1 | tail -2)) ; which Xvfb && echo OK

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && (which Xvfb || (apt-get install -y -qq xvfb 2>&1 | tail -2)) ; which Xvfb && echo OK", "summary": "Install Xvfb for headed browser", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "timeout": 300}
